issues.title: Brave webcam white screen with background effects on Wayland
issues.description: Google Meet background blur/effects cause solid white webcam output in Brave on KDE Plasma Wayland. Root cause: eglCreateImage failures in Chromium's Ozone/Wayland GPU compositing path.

issues.title: OOM safety net (earlyoom) + vm.swappiness=80 — local tuning on top of OOTB
issues.description: Kubuntu ships no OOM daemon (kubuntu-desktop seed omits systemd-oomd; oomd is unworkable on KDE user cgroups anyway). Installed earlyoom -M 2097152,1048576 -s 100 (2GiB/1GiB floors sized vs 100ms poll x 6GiB/s fill, covers LLM mmap bursts). Bumped vm.swappiness 60->80 from this host refault data.
issues.workaround: earlyoom + /etc/default/earlyoom + /etc/sysctl.d/99-vm-swappiness.conf, reproduced by dotfiles hosts/peregrine/host.sh. REVISIT swappiness ~2026-07-13 vs ~/.cache/swap-tuning-baseline/.
